# GenuDo

> Genuine AI employees for every team — agents grounded in your knowledge, with tools, channels and pipelines, that reply, act and close work across WhatsApp, Instagram, webchat and email, 24/7.

GenuDo turns your playbooks into reusable AI employees: an agent shaped with a
persona, model and guardrails, grounded in your knowledge, connected to your
tools, put to work on your channels through a pipeline — with humans in control
via a shared inbox. The site is available in English (`/en`) and Egyptian
Arabic (`/ar`). Base URL: https://genudo.ai

## Product
- [How it works](https://genudo.ai/en/how-it-works): From first message to sale. AI employees, pipelines, follow-ups, your own knowledge, capped AI cost, channels and analytics.
- [Who is GENU](https://genudo.ai/en/who-is-genu): The guide to your AI workforce: Aaref, Adnan and ROZ.
- [Integrations](https://genudo.ai/en/integrations): WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, website chat, calendars, CRMs and helpdesks.
- [API & MCP](https://genudo.ai/en/api-mcp): Set up and coach your AI employees from Claude or ChatGPT.

## Solutions (AI employees)
- [Aaref, AI sales employee](https://genudo.ai/en/sol-sales-agent): Aaref answers every inquiry, follows up with quiet leads and books meetings.
- [Adnan, AI support employee](https://genudo.ai/en/sol-customer-service): Adnan answers customers from your own policies, any hour.
- [ROZ, quality and operations](https://genudo.ai/en/sol-operations): ROZ reviews how your team replies on WhatsApp.
